EXECUTION-ONLY — BUILD AND CONNECT THE REAL MISSION CONTROL MCP BRIDGE, THEN FINISH PR #58 LIVE ACCEPTANCE

Repo: u-dont-existDOTcom/universal-dev-architecture
PR: #58
Branch: task/mission-control-vps-browser-relay-20260902
Current head at handoff: 7571a63f0244980644b8e3a5c5fb40cf03cc265d
Hotfix service only: mission-control-hotfix / 5b593609-ad2a-458c-bed0-ea344b6c6f33
Production service: e1db3d50-b963-42d2-a21d-b52601fcfb92 — DO NOT TOUCH
Hostinger specialist chat: https://chatgpt.com/c/6a9847f8-3a44-83ea-9b41-181a240b2c26
Logical chat: mc-hotfix-specialist
Worker: mission-control-live-slice
Expected model labels: Extra High / Pro

CHAT-RESOLVED ARCHITECTURE
Use a proper remote MCP app instead of asking ChatGPT web/connected-reader to fetch arbitrary Railway pages.

Current OpenAI product support, verified from official docs:
- Pro users can connect custom MCPs with read/fetch permissions in developer mode.
- Remote MCP servers use Streamable HTTP.
- Official TypeScript SDK is @modelcontextprotocol/sdk.
- Anonymous/read-only tools are explicitly supported; customer-specific/private data should use OAuth.
- App selection is per message; an app can be selected from Tools or referred to in the prompt.

SECURITY DECISION
DO NOT expose private Mission Control worker timelines or substantive project content anonymously.
DO NOT build ad-hoc OAuth in this queue.
Instead, expose ONLY non-sensitive control-plane metadata through an anonymous READ-ONLY MCP. Substantive evidence remains in GitHub, where the existing authorized-writer/issue allowlists control receipts.

This preserves the two-source proof:
- Mission Control MCP = live admission/control metadata
- GitHub = durable evidence + write receipt bus

A. IMPLEMENT REMOTE MCP SERVER
Add a remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint to the Mission Control app using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk + zod, following the official MCP SDK transport pattern already supported by the current Node/Next.js stack.

Preferred endpoint: POST/GET as required by Streamable HTTP at /mcp or /api/mcp — use the smallest framework-compatible route. It must be a standards-compliant remote MCP endpoint that ChatGPT's custom-app tool scan can consume.

Server identity:
- name: mission-control
- stable version bound to repo app version or 1.0.0

NO write tools. NO arbitrary search/list enumeration.

Tools (names may use snake_case exactly below unless SDK/framework forces a harmless naming convention):

1. get_capability_challenge
Input:
- challenge_id: string
- chat_id: string
Output ONLY:
- schema_version
- challenge_id
- chat_id
- mc_nonce
- github_nonce_sha256
- github_nonce_source
- receipt_target
- expires_at
Rules:
- exact configured/current challenge only
- challenge/chat binding must match
- unknown/mismatch => MCP error / not found
- expired => fail closed
- no extra refs/timeline/worker data

2. get_supervisory_request_binding
Input:
- request_id: string
- chat_id: string
Output ONLY current admitted control metadata needed to bind a supervisor turn:
- schema_version
- request_id
- request_nonce
- chat_id
- worker_id
- reasoning_lane (EXTRA_HIGH_DIRECT|PRO_ESCALATED)
- queued_at
- expires_at
- evidence_capsule_id
- evidence_capsule_sha256
- owner_outcome_id
- owner_outcome_epoch
- owner_outcome_sha256
- github_repository
- decision_issue_number
- stage_issue_number
- canonical receipt/stage target URLs or identifiers already accepted by policy
- current admission/route status if non-sensitive and already deterministic
NO factual packet body, worker transcript, owner message body, secrets, credentials, tokens, private state, or arbitrary evidence payload.
Rules:
- exact pending/current admitted request + exact chat only
- unknown/stale/expired/wrong chat => fail closed
- no listing all requests
- no guessing/fuzzy matches

3. get_stage_liveness_state
Input:
- request_id
- chat_id
Output ONLY:
- request_id
- chat_id
- latest EXTRA_HIGH_READER status/receipt id/occurred_at if present
- latest PRO_REASONER status/receipt id/occurred_at if present
- counts of CONTINUE_REQUIRED if needed for deterministic liveness limits
- semantic_authority:false
NO decision body or assistant content.

4. Optional get_current_receipt_state ONLY if needed by the existing relay to verify #59/#60/#61 ingestion without reading private content. Output IDs/status/timestamps only. Do not add it unless it removes a real mechanical gap.

All tools must declare read-only/noauth security metadata compatible with ChatGPT custom apps. Do not expose a list/search tool that can enumerate workers/requests.

B. KEEP THE EXISTING PUBLIC HTTP CHALLENGE ENDPOINT
Do not remove the existing /api/capability-challenges/<challenge-id> route. It remains useful diagnostic evidence, but the supervisor should use the MCP tool for the actual proof.

C. TEST THE MCP SECURITY BOUNDARY
Add deterministic tests proving:
- initialize/tools/list succeeds using MCP protocol;
- each expected read-only tool is discoverable;
- no write/mutation tool exists;
- challenge tool returns exactly allowlisted fields;
- request binding returns exactly allowlisted control-plane fields;
- wrong chat/unknown/stale/expired request/challenge fails closed;
- stage state contains no semantic decision content;
- worker timeline/body/credentials/session/token/env/Railway variables cannot appear in structured outputs;
- no list-all/enumeration interface;
- tool calls do not mutate the event ledger;
- existing Mission Control auth-protected worker APIs remain protected;
- existing capability/receipt verification semantics remain unchanged.

D. UPDATE RELAY PROMPTS TO USE THE MCP APP
Capability prompt must explicitly instruct Extra High to use the custom app Mission Control and tool get_capability_challenge for exact challenge/chat, then follow github_nonce_source with GitHub, hash-check, and write exactly one #60 receipt.

For ordinary/escalated supervision prompts:
- instruct the supervisor to use Mission Control.get_supervisory_request_binding for the exact request/chat BEFORE reasoning;
- use GitHub for substantive evidence and canonical receipt writes;
- use Mission Control.get_stage_liveness_state only where current stage metadata is needed.
Do not include the MC nonce or request nonce directly in browser prompt if the MCP can provide it; the point is that the chat actually reads current MC state.

Keep browser hard boundary: no assistant-output extraction.

E. CI / CODE QUALITY
Run focused MCP tests first, then one normal hosted final checkpoint:
- repo deterministic audit
- Mission Control tests/types/build
- relay tests/syntax
- CodeQL
No redundant all-green reruns.
Push exact new head. PR remains draft during live proof.

F. DEPLOY HOTFIX EXACT SHA
Update ONLY mission-control-hotfix to exact new SHA via the established codeload exact-SHA build mechanism.
Require:
- exact SHA in build log
- successful Next.js build/typecheck
- MCP route live
- daemon started
- healthcheck success
- production untouched

Use MCP Inspector or a standards-compatible direct MCP client mechanically if available to prove initialize + tools/list + one safe challenge call against the hotfix endpoint before touching ChatGPT settings.

G. CONNECT CUSTOM MCP APP IN HOSTINGER CHATGPT PRO
Use the existing authenticated dedicated ChatGPT browser profile on Hostinger.

1. Navigate to ChatGPT Settings -> Apps -> Advanced Settings / Developer Mode (current UI may vary).
2. Enable Developer Mode for this Pro account if disabled.
3. Create a custom app named exactly Mission Control (or Mission Control Dev only if name collision requires it; if so update relay prompts to exact final name).
4. Endpoint = hotfix remote MCP endpoint.
5. Authentication = no authentication / anonymous, because all exposed tools are intentionally non-sensitive control-plane reads only.
6. Scan Tools.
7. Verify ONLY the intended read-only tools appear. If any unexpected write/mutation/private-data tool appears, FAIL CLOSED and do not create/enable the app.
8. Create/enable the draft app for this user.
9. Do not publish workspace-wide; this is a private developer-mode smoke app.
10. Do not change global plugin permissions more broadly than necessary.

If developer mode is unavailable on this Pro account despite current official support, stop with exact blocker CHATGPT_PRO_CUSTOM_MCP_DEVELOPER_MODE_UNAVAILABLE and capture non-content UI evidence only.
If app creation requires an interactive account credential not already authenticated, stop at the exact login/approval blocker without asking for passwords.

H. PROVE APP TOOL USE BEFORE CAPABILITY WRITE
In the exact registered HumanDesign specialist chat, with normal sends disabled:
1. Perform a harmless app-read preflight in Extra High that calls Mission Control.get_capability_challenge for the exact challenge/chat.
2. Do NOT inspect assistant message content in browser.
3. Prove tool use by external server/MCP access log/structured telemetry containing only tool name, challenge/chat IDs, response status, timestamp — never model output.
4. Keep global 60-second pacing.
If app invocation cannot be triggered by natural prompt reference, mechanically select Mission Control from the Tools/apps UI for that message, using non-content controls only. Patch the relay minimally if recurring per-message app selection is required.

I. RERUN #60 CAPABILITY PROOF
Once MCP preflight proves live read:
- capability gate only; MC_RELAY_SUBMIT_ENABLED=0
- exact Extra High
- tool call to Mission Control.get_capability_challenge
- GitHub read/hash
- exact #60 write
- Mission Control ingestion
PASS requires missionControlRead=true, githubRead=true, githubWrite=true, modeSwitching=true.
Disable capability gate after proof.

J. CONTINUE ORIGINAL LIVE ACCEPTANCE AUTOMATICALLY
If #60 passes, continue WITHOUT returning to owner:
1. ONE harmless ordinary EXTRA_HIGH_DIRECT synthetic route:
   - MCP request binding read
   - GitHub evidence read
   - GitHub #59 canonical decision write
   - Mission Control ingestion
2. ONE harmless PRO_ESCALATED route:
   - Extra High MCP request binding + GitHub evidence reader
   - #61 reader STAGE_COMPLETE
   - >=60s pacing
   - same-chat Pro reasoner
   - >=60s pacing
   - Extra High liveness checker using MC/GitHub stage state as designed
   - #61 STAGE_COMPLETE or CONTINUE_REQUIRED
   - if CONTINUE_REQUIRED: paced same-chat Pro continue, then check again
   - Extra High writer -> #59 final canonical decision -> MC ingestion
3. Verify public missed-webhook reconciliation for #59/#60/#61.
4. Verify live MCP calls are control-plane read only and no unexpected app confirmation/write prompts occur.
5. Capture real send spacing >=60s and RAM/browser/relay peaks.
6. Provider-bound transcript timestamp: prove it if source-sent time is genuinely available through the accepted evidence path; otherwise keep requirement explicitly unmet. Do NOT relabel capture/generation time as source-sent time.
7. Stuck recovery only if naturally needed; do not burn quota to manufacture a stall.

K. FINAL STATE / MERGE BOUNDARY
After all live acceptance:
- keep normal Hostinger relay disabled unless existing accepted PR requirements explicitly require turning it on continuously at this stage; default leave disabled until promotion.
- update PR #58 and issue #53 with exact receipts.
- mark ready/merge ONLY if all original terminal acceptance is satisfied and durable existing merge policy makes it deterministic. Otherwise stop MERGE_POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED.
- production promotion is NOT authorized by this task unless explicit durable policy already authorizes it; otherwise stop PRODUCTION_PROMOTION_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED after acceptance.

NON-NEGOTIABLES
- Work executes only; no architecture redesign.
- no private MC content in anonymous MCP.
- no write MCP tools.
- no ad-hoc OAuth.
- no assistant output DOM extraction.
- no production Railway changes.
- no model alias invention.
- no secrets in logs/GitHub/user-visible receipts.
- no owner relaying intermediate packets.

RETURN RECEIPT
- final head
- MCP endpoint and tool names
- exact allowlisted schemas
- security tests
- hosted CI/CodeQL
- hotfix deployment id/exact SHA
- ChatGPT developer-mode custom app creation result
- MCP tool-read telemetry proof
- #60 capability receipt + booleans
- #59 ordinary receipt
- #61 escalated receipts + final #59
- actual send timestamps/min spacing
- memory T0/peak/final
- timestamp-proof result
- current relay/app enablement state
- exact remaining blocker, if any.
